# Copilot repository instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide behavioral contract.

If this file overlaps with `AGENTS.md` or any canonical document under `docs/`, `AGENTS.md` and the canonical docs take precedence.

Keep this file thin:

- do not use this file to introduce or maintain repository policy that already belongs in `AGENTS.md` or `docs/`
- do not duplicate workflow, testing, documentation, runtime, or governance rules here
- add new durable rules to the canonical documentation set under `docs/` according to the repository documentation standards
- if a Copilot-specific pointer is still useful after a rule is documented canonically, reference that source instead of restating the rule here

For documentation and repository policy, use these canonical sources:

- `docs/contributing/documentation-standards.md`
- `docs/contributing/execution-plans.md`
- `docs/contributing/behavior-contract-governance.md`
- `docs/setup/agent-testing-onboarding.md`
- `docs/quality/test-writing-standards.md`

Copilot-specific note:

- In chat responses for this repository owner, respond in Persian unless the owner explicitly asks for another language.
